definitions.explanation: A medical doctor who specializes in performing surgical operations.

examples.japanese: {外科医|げかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I want to become a surgeon.

examples.japanese: {外科医|げかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The surgeon explained the operation to me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{外科医|げかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、⟦わざわざ→わざわざ：06073_wazawaza⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: I heard there's a skilled surgeon there, so I go out of my way to visit that hospital.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{外科|げか}→外科：03983_geka⟧ (surgery, the surgical department) + {医|い} (doctor). Refers specifically to a doctor who performs surgery, as opposed to one who treats patients through medication or other non-surgical means.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{心臓|しんぞう}→心臓：03262_shinzou⟧{外科医|げかい}: cardiac surgeon
- ⟦{脳|のう}→脳：03537_nou⟧{外科医|げかい}: neurosurgeon
- ⟦{整形|せいけい}→整形：09493_seikei⟧{外科医|げかい}: orthopedic surgeon
- ⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{外科医|げかい}: skilled surgeon

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {内科医|ないかい}: internist — a doctor who treats diseases without surgery
- ⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧: physician, doctor — the general term for a medical doctor
- ⟦{執刀医|しっとうい}→執刀医：17895_shittoui⟧: operating surgeon — the doctor who actually performs the surgery (more specific)
